column1: # Devī Bhāgavatam: collation of the Wikisource e-text with the Gita Press edition
# (Śrīmaddevībhāgavata Mahāpurāṇa with Hindi translation, Gorakhpur, 2010 printing;
# volumes). Gita Press is a modern copyrighted edition, used only to check readings;
# its text and Hindi are not copied. Read for the skandhas no Khemraj scan covers.
# Spelling conventions are not collated (anusvāra for a class nasal, avagraha,
# doubling, word division). One line per difference, tab-separated:
#   part  adhyāya  verse  op  e-text  gita-press  [leaf]
# op r = an e-text slip (a misspelt or broken word where Gita Press has the plain
# reading), corrected by gen.py; v = an edition variant (both readings sound), kept
